name: Nijikoi no Houkago
source: Experience the story of high school in 3 years that can determine your life. Enjoy along with many events and activities so your daily life won’t be boring and come up with a new feeling like you never felt before. What are you waiting for? Join us now at Hoshisora high school!
translation: 体验三年内决定你人生的高中故事。享受许多活动和活动，这样你的日常生活就不会无聊，并带来前所未有的新感觉。你还在等什么？现在就加入星空高中吧！
